Again, billions from your pockets to Big Oil — coincidence?

While you’re at it, look at your electric bill, hiked by Republicans blocking low-cost clean energy.

Your bill goes up (the total is in the billions) and the extra you pay goes to fossil fuel units that wouldn’t even be running if the low-cost energy was on the grid.
Yes, a quarter-trillion dollars from your pockets to theirs — you still don’t think this is on purpose?

That extra $45 billion you paid is just the appetizer; the real feast is nearly a quarter-trillion dollars of excess Big Oil profit coming out of your pockets over the rest of this year.
